summary: Iteration 6 (cross-industry catalog expansion) tested end-to-end. Backend: 22 pytest cases across careers/skills/locations/location-careers/career-x-location + market-insights regressions — all 22 passed (50 careers, 12 categories, 31 skills w/ categories, 30 locations with top flag, exactly 1500 combos, registered-nurse/miami-fl returns jobs:[] + salary_range:null + salary_us 65k-110k, data-analyst/chicago-il still returns platform jobs + salary_range, unknown slug -> 404, no _id leakage). Frontend: /careers hub renders all 12 category headings (career-category-*) with 50 cards; /skills hub renders 9 skill-category groups (patient-care, accounting, salesforce, communication present); /careers/registered-nurse shows H1 + 'Illustrative U.S. range' $65k-$110k with methodology link; /careers/registered-nurse/in/miami-fl shows the encouraging 'Thinking about becoming a Registered Nurse in Miami, FL?' copy, illustrative pay stat and core-skill chips (no dead-end main message); electrician/austin-tx and accountant/new-york-ny render; /locations/chicago-il shows cross-industry H1 'Jobs & Careers in Chicago, IL' + 12 diverse loc-career-* chips linking to /careers/<slug>/in/chicago-il; regression pages /careers/data-analyst, /jobs, /market-insights render with zero console errors. Two content/SEO defects found (broken skill chip links, empty section on job-less location pages).

ui_bugs.component: Careers.jsx CareerDetail / Places.jsx LocationCareer - core skill chips
ui_bugs.issue: Core-skill chips link unconditionally to /skills/<slugified-name>, but only 30 of the 108 distinct core_skills exist in the SKILLS catalog. 78 slugs (clinical-assessment, ehr-systems, medication-administration, electrical-systems, welding-techniques, lesson-planning, linux, terraform, typescript, data-analysis, ...) land on a bare 'Skill not found' page. Verified: /skills/clinical-assessment -> 'Skill not found', GET /api/seo/skills/clinical-assessment -> 404. This is a large internal-broken-link / soft-404 surface across the new non-tech careers, directly harmful to the SEO/GEO discovery goal.

skillSlug = s.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g,'-') does not strip non-alphanumerics, so 'HTML/CSS' produces /skills/html/css which falls through the router and silently renders the HOME page (h1 'Find the right talent.Get hired faster.') instead of a 404/not-found page.

On locations with no platform jobs (e.g. /locations/miami-fl) the 'In-demand skills here' heading renders with an empty body (no chips, blank whitespace) and the intro copy says 'lists 0 open roles sourced locally'. Section should be hidden or fall back to cross-industry skill chips like the careers section does.

issues: Two of the three stat cards read '0' (0 Open Registered Nurse roles here, 0 Verified candidates) — the surrounding copy is encouraging as intended, but the double zero still reads as a dead end; consider replacing with guidance stats when counts are zero
Footer CAREERS/SKILLS columns are still tech-only (Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Backend Engineer / SQL, Python, Power BI, AWS, React) — inconsistent with the new cross-industry framing

action_items: Render core-skill chips as plain (non-link) chips unless the skill slug exists in the skills catalog, or add the missing high-value non-tech skills to SKILLS (clinical-assessment, ehr-systems, medication-administration, electrical-systems, hvac-systems, plumbing-systems, welding-techniques, blueprint-reading, lesson-planning, classroom-management, instructional-design, employee-relations, recruiting, inventory-management, logistics, safety-compliance, troubleshooting, data-analysis, problem-solving)
Harden skill/career slugification (strip all non-alphanumerics) and add a real NotFound route so /skills/html/css does not silently render the home page
Hide or provide a fallback for the 'In-demand skills here' section on locations with no platform jobs (/locations/miami-fl)
Optional: replace zero-value stat cards on job-less career x city pages with guidance-oriented stats; broaden footer career/skill links to non-tech examples
critical_code_review_comments: Careers.jsx:89 and the equivalent chip renderers duplicate ad-hoc slugification; extract a shared slugify() helper and gate links on catalog membership (the frontend already fetches /api/seo/skills, so the valid slug set is available).
seo_content.py is now ~700+ lines of data; consider splitting careers/skills/locations into separate data modules to keep it maintainable.
No backend validation issue found: all SEO endpoints return correct 200/404 codes and exclude Mongo _id.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (all requested render checks passed; 3 link/empty-section defects)

seed_data_creation: None — all tested endpoints are read-only public content.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for the expanded catalog lives at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_catalog_expansion.py (22 tests, all passing; run with pytest from /app/backend). Prerender was NOT tested per instructions. Remaining open items are frontend-only: broken /skills/<slug> chip links for the 78 core skills absent from the SKILLS catalog, /skills/html/css falling back to the home page, and the empty 'In-demand skills here' section on job-less location pages.
rca_of_the_issue: The catalog expansion grew CAREERS to 50 (108 distinct core_skills strings) but SKILLS only to 31. Chip renderers link to /skills/<slug> unconditionally with no membership check, so any core skill without a curated page produces a 'Skill not found' dead end. Reproduce: open /careers/registered-nurse and click 'Clinical Assessment'.
